capabilities: Print note properties as a header in the core PDF export
Preview the printable header in reading view before exporting
Hide or reorder which properties appear in the header
Format the header as a table or compact layout
Apply per-folder layout rules with the paid Pro tier
extras: Freemium: free tier covers headers, hide list, ordering and both layouts; Pro adds per-folder layouts and requires GitHub sign-in via device flow. The plugin only makes network requests after sign-in and stores the token in Obsidian's secret storage. After updates it opens a What's new tab that suggests other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled). Desktop only: mobile PDF export is outside this version; requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later.
intentEvidence: Print the properties of a note as a readable header in Obsidian's built-in PDF export
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF export omits frontmatter, so shared PDFs lose author, date, tags and other property values unless you copy them into the note body.

relations.evidence: Choose Advanced PDF Export for those document controls. Choose this plugin for a labeled property header
Complete PDF Export also supports property cards through its own export workflow.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Header generator that prints note properties as a readable block at the top of PDFs made with Obsidian's built-in PDF export.
